answer.text:
**Intel** had the higher R&D intensity: **31.2%** of revenue in FY2024, versus **9.9%** for NVIDIA in FY2025. The difference was **21.3 percentage points** (31.2% − 9.9%).

Intel’s filing reports R&D of **$16,546 million** and net revenue of **$53,101 million** (16,546 ÷ 53,101 ≈ 31.2%); NVIDIA reports R&D at **9.9% of revenue**. *(Intel: accession 0000050863-25-000009, “Filing Summary,” chunk 13; NVIDIA: accession 0001045810-25-000023, “Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” chunk 2.)*
